text: These are the 2026 public holidays in Berlin. On public holidays, most businesses are closed, and employees get a paid day off.
In 2026, there are 10 public holidays, but 3 are on a weekend.
In 2027, there are 10 public holidays, but 4 are on a weekend.

title: Employees get a paid day off
text: On public holidays, you still get paid, but you don’t have to work. If you were not supposed to work, you don’t get paid. For example, if you only work on Mondays and Fridays, and the public holiday is on a Tuesday, you don’t get paid. If you work part-time, and you don’t have a fixed schedule, public holidays are rarely paid. If you work in another state, you celebrate the holidays of the state where you work. For example, if you live in Brandenburg, and you work in Berlin, you get a paid day off when it’s a public holiday in Berlin. If you are on vacation during a public holiday, you still get a free day off. You don’t need to use a vacation day. For example, if you are on vacation for 5 days, and 1 day is a public holiday, you only use 4 vacation days. How vacation days work in Germany

title: Businesses are closed
text: On public holidays, most businesses are closed, just like on Sundays. Supermarkets are also closed, so you must buy food in advance. What is open on public holidays?

title: Public transit still works
text: On public holidays, you can still use trains, trams and buses. Trains are less frequent, like on Sundays. How to use public transit

title: Each state is different
text: Different German states have different public holidays. Some states have more public holidays than other.
